label: Notify
description: Sends a message to people when something happens. Choose who receives it, how urgently, and which wording to use.

event.label: Event
event.description: What happened, e.g. "proposal approved". Used to choose the message wording. If left blank, the name of this step is used.

template.label: Template
template.description: The wording of the message, named by its template folder under /libs/iap/notificationTemplates/.

urgency.label: Urgency
urgency.description: How soon the recipients should hear about it.

recipients.label: Recipients
recipients.description: Who to tell: "@creator" for the person who raised the item, or any person or group.
